title: Define counting semantics and golden counting tests
description:
Define and implement the counting semantics: each match occurrence increments its family token count; a message contributes at most once per family to the message-level count; the meter gauge uses token counts. Pin golden expected counts for the fixture corpus.

Done when: occurrence and message-level counts are both produced; golden counting tests over the fixture skeleton pass deterministically; the same input always yields the same counts.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Semantics pinned: every match occurrence increments the family token count; a message contributes at most once per family to messageCount; the meter gauge uses token counts. Golden tests in tests/unit/sentiment/counting.spec.ts cover boundaries, exclusions, both-family messages, and determinism (pure function of text + word list). 17 counting tests green. Outcome: green.
